scope: D-P01 brief only; exact plan unreleased at discovery freeze

source_index.note: Source IDs and bounded evidence notes are anchored in this index.

sources.observed_operation: Opened normative Recommendation; read located criteria in page text.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Text identification applies when an error is detected; suggestions apply when known unless security/purpose would be jeopardized; status messages are programmatically exposed without focus; resize 200%; reflow at 320 CSS px with two-dimensional-layout exception.
sources.applicability: Normative baseline for error, status, zoom and reflow behavior; does not dictate one summary pattern or establish translation/AT compatibility.

sources.version_or_commit: WCAG 2.2 Understanding supporting document; live and informative, no fixed release shown
sources.locator: SC 4.1.3 intent, definition, examples and live-region note
sources.observed_operation: Opened page and inspected focus and chatty-risk guidance.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Applies to non-context-changing status about outcomes, waiting, progress or errors; roles/properties expose without focus; no obligation to create extra messages; overly chatty live regions are a risk.
sources.applicability: Supports concise, non-focus-taking state updates and a testable announcement policy; informative, not compatibility proof.

sources.observed_operation: Opened page; reviewed markup and test steps.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Do not set aria-invalid=true before validation; on real failure associate readable text with the field; technique is sufficient example, not mandatory method.
sources.applicability: HTML implementation option for field error state/association; no universal AT guarantee.

sources.version_or_commit: WAI Forms Tutorial live page; no fixed publication version shown
sources.locator: Overall feedback, error listing, inline feedback, After submit, During typing
sources.observed_operation: Opened tutorial and inspected example and explanatory text.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Uses overall and inline errors; example links summary entries and aria-describedby; submit example suggests focus to first invalid input; typed availability demo uses polite live region and a local synchronous list.
sources.applicability: Patterns for message timing/association; typing demo does not establish async freshness or AT compatibility.

sources.version_or_commit: WCAG 2.2 Understanding supporting document; live and informative
sources.locator: SC 1.4.10; basic text reflow; viewport equivalence
sources.observed_operation: Opened page and reviewed viewport threshold and exceptions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Vertical content reflows at 320 CSS px without loss or two-axis scrolling; two-dimensional layout exception limited to sections requiring it.
sources.applicability: Supports narrow and zoomed layout validation; not evidence that translation-expanded strings fit.

sources.version_or_commit: WHATWG HTML Living Standard, moving document, no fixed release or commit
sources.locator: §3.2.6.2 language determination; §3.2.6.4 dir attribute and Auto state
sources.observed_operation: Opened DOM section and inspected lang/dir behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: lang supplies language metadata; dir permits ltr/rtl/auto; auto uses a crude first-strong heuristic and is urged only when direction is truly unknown and no better server-side heuristic exists.
sources.applicability: Use explicit locale direction for interface; reserve auto for unknown-direction input. Does not prove full RTL rendering or translation quality.

sources.version_or_commit: WHATWG HTML Living Standard, moving document; retrieved result dated 2026-09-08, no fixed release or commit
sources.observed_operation: Opened form-control infrastructure and located constraint-validation security language.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Client-side constraint checks are for UX and may be bypassed or absent; server must not rely on them.
sources.applicability: Client checks can be immediate hints; server must validate authoritative decision rules and writes.

sources.version_or_commit: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series maintained page; no fixed release/commit exposed
sources.locator: Input Validation Strategies; Implementing Input Validation; Common Pitfalls
sources.observed_operation: Opened page and reviewed strategy and client-only-check entries.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Validate syntax and semantics; repeat server-side despite client checks; client checks give immediate feedback; Unicode free-form text should not be narrowed to ASCII without a domain rule.
sources.applicability: Authority split and note-text validation framing; portal-specific rules remain owner decisions.

sources.observed_operation: Opened RFC and located If-Match and 412 sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Origin server evaluates If-Match before a state-changing method; false condition means method not performed, with 412 response permitted; RFC allows an already-succeeded exception described in §13.1.1.
sources.applicability: Possible version-conditional save for concurrent reviewers; requires API enforcement and does not specify UI conflict resolution.

sources.version_or_commit: Live maintained GOV.UK Design System documentation, no fixed version; recent history on page through Frontend v6.2.0
sources.locator: How it works; example markup; field links; recent changes
sources.observed_operation: Opened current guidance, markup example and change history.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Summary and inline errors on validation failures; focus summary; link every error to field; identical wording; nested role=alert; history says v4.4.0 changed alert placement for JAWS full-summary issue.
sources.applicability: Maintained error-navigation pattern. Delayed-focus adaptation needed when response arrives after the user moves; language/AT support not verified.

sources.version_or_commit: GOV.UK Frontend v6.5.1, release commit efdc06c, released 2026-09-14; shown latest at access
sources.observed_operation: Opened signed release record and inspected version, commit and note.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Fix release lists a service-navigation example change, not error-summary change.
sources.applicability: Establishes maintained candidate version only; not version-specific error-summary verification.

sources.observed_operation: Opened issue and read audit report, attributed cause and closure/retest notes.

sources.observed_operation: Opened PR referenced in issue #1410 and reviewed its discussion/history.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Specific repair concerned focus setup for the legacy full-page example; not asynchronous SPA focus behavior.
sources.applicability: Fix lineage for one failure, not a general focus prescription.

sources.version_or_commit: Historical accessibility audit issue 2799, opened 2023-05-24, page marked closed/done
sources.locator: Description, code reference, user feedback, proposed solution, status
sources.observed_operation: Opened issue and inspected broken href/input ID, report and status.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Error summary link fragment mismatched target ID and inline error was absent; users could not get to the field; proposed fix matches fragment to input ID.
sources.applicability: Concrete summary-link regression case; not evidence that this portal or a specific release is fixed.

sources.version_or_commit: Live USWDS docs; download link v3.14.0; validation component unsupported after v3.12.0 per page; immutable component commit not inspected
sources.locator: About the validation component; code/guidance; Known issues; Latest updates
sources.observed_operation: Opened page; reviewed live example, lifecycle caveat and history.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Top client-side checklist/live feedback; docs require server mirroring and report component usability/accessibility issues and no support after 3.12.0.
sources.applicability: Alternative/caution; do not presume progressive live checks are noticed or understood.

sources.version_or_commit: Historical issue opened 2023-11-28; closed as not planned
sources.locator: Summary; observations; implementation recommendations; research method
sources.observed_operation: Opened public issue and read research summary and disposition.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Five high-fidelity prototype participants using screen reader and/or magnification did not notice changed validation status; expected inline or submit-time errors.
sources.applicability: Specific small-study caution for live checklist feedback; not a universal user or AT claim.

sources.observed_operation: Opened issue and inspected test finding.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Four screen-reader and/or magnification participants in a form prototype were confused by the top message and expected inline or submit-time validation.
sources.applicability: Prototype-specific evidence against assuming a top success checklist is self-explanatory.

sources.version_or_commit: WCAG 2.2 Understanding supporting document, updated 2026-06-12; informative
sources.locator: SC 3.3.1 interpretation; User agent native HTML form validation
sources.observed_operation: Opened page and reviewed native validation behavior and limitations.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Native form validation generally prevents submit and focuses first invalid control with generic message; messages may not persist/magnify; only first error may be exposed per attempt.
sources.applicability: A low-customization alternative with user-agent-controlled limits; does not replace server authority.

limitations: No portal code, design system version, API contract, locale catalogue, user data, assistive technology or test environment was provided or inspected.
No translation-quality or assistive-technology compatibility claim is made.
Provider pages and public examples were inspected, but no implementation, browser, screen-reader, integration or multilingual usability test was run.
